_comment: Every code a filename may contain. List order IS canonical order. Aliases are the spellings producers already use; the builder accepts them and writes the code. Edit here, never in a producer. See README.md.

sources.name: an independent pilot cohort, written pilot-YYYYMMDD (its first recording day); each pilot is its own cohort

several pilot cohorts side by side on one deliverable, written pilots-YYYYMMDD-YYYYMMDD[...] with the days oldest first. Each pilot's treatment and groups are fixed by its own code, so the name does not repeat them, and could not within the length cap

synthetic: simulated, not recorded. Absent means real data. Its dataset fields are each optional, written only when the simulation mimics them (a fast-stream fit, DI against OVX), and found by their registered codes; a free topic last says what the simulation is

types.name: parameter recovery: planted (or known) values against the values a measurement recovered
an explainer: a document about an idea or method, not about a dataset
an export: a folder of data a consumer ingests (fireflies from 2R/, bugarach from exports/<consumer>/). Its files are named by the export rules, its screens are in manifest.json

forms.name: a figure or page drawn from the data
the data themselves: a folder, or a table

signals.name: straight ROI fluorescence, no penumbra subtraction

streams.name: fast stream (FAST = CMS, custard minus slow)
every fast and slow onset per ROI, merged, nothing dropped (bugarach src/bugarach/combined.py)
raw fast-channel detector, approximately fast + slow; NOT an alias of either

windows.name: 5-minute window; a slice is kept only if every window it exports is the full length, first treatment only (interface2 aCa5z run mode short_window_5_strict)
20-minute window; a slice is kept only if every window it exports is the full length, first treatment only (interface2 aCa5z run mode long_window_20_strict)

thresholds.name: detection threshold 4 x sigma_est (fast ROI_MLspike_sigmaest_4, slow ROI_slow_filtfilt_4); the canonical pairing

mocos.name: non-rigid motion correction (NoRMCorre); can pin ROIs to the frame floor (interface2 docs/moco_floor_pinning.md)

reviews.name: events inside the reviewer's blank windows removed, listed in review_blanked_excluded.tsv

keeps.name: dead ROIs removed by the full-trace rule: one event in fast or slow anywhere in the trace keeps a ROI
fireflies: ROI dropped if empty in baseline and treatment
fireflies: ROI dropped if empty in baseline, treatment and high K+ (01-scripts/rejection_rule.R)

tables.name: per-ROI per-region frequency/duration in the aCa5z schema, per-second units (was <prefix>_ROI_<STREAM>_<win>_<date>_clean.csv)
pilot frequency/amplitude/width diagnostic, custard+slow+fast in one table, PER-MINUTE units (was pilot_fsw_factor<f>_<win>.csv)

export_files._comment: Names fixed by a consumer's contract or by the export rules. Checked by exact membership, never renamed. A recording is <slice_id>.csv (bugarach contract). Markdown is prose and is not checked.

export_rules._comment: Rules only exports follow. A treatment field lists every treatment region the export holds, high K+ included (Tony, 2026-10-12); baseline is implied.

moco_pools._comment: a cohort with slices of both kinds is pooled: flex+rigid

inboxes._comment: Where exports are written, under the Dropbox data root. Each child folder of an inbox is one export. 'exports/*' means every consumer folder under exports/. A directory starting with '_' (a holding area: _hold, _superseded, _quarantine) and the names in 'skip' are not exports.

checked_from._comment: An export folder holding any entry older than this day predates the export scheme and is not checked: existing exports keep their names (Tony, 2026-10-12). Renaming starts with the first batch built after the extension lands.

_comment_thr: thr on a deliverable is optional (Tony, 2026-10-12): written when the page is not the canonical 4x, or whenever a producer chooses; no thr field means thr4x. On an export it is required.
